references.text: A similar introductory formula where the Lord speaks to Moses, used consistently throughout the Torah to introduce divine commands.
The standard formula 'the Lord spoke to Moses' that introduces legislation and instructions in Leviticus.
The opening formula in Numbers where the Lord speaks to Moses, establishing the pattern for divine communication in this book.
A parallel introduction in the same book where the Lord gives Moses instructions regarding the camp of Israel.
The same introductory formula used before the instructions concerning the Nazirite vow, just before the chapter on the consecration of the Levites.
